papers.title: A Compartmental Model for Influenza A Transmission Dynamics
papers.notes: SEIR model for influenza with age stratification. Includes vaccination compartments.

papers.title: Compartmental Models for Influenza Transmission: A Systematic Review
papers.notes: Review of compartmental models for influenza, includes SIR, SEIR, and extended models.

papers.notes: SEIR model with latent and active TB compartments. Includes reinfection dynamics.

papers.notes: Classic TB compartmental model with latent (E) and active (I) compartments.

papers.notes: Age-stratified dengue model with vector compartments. Includes multiple serotypes.

papers.title: Ebola Virus Disease: A Compartmental Model for Outbreak Analysis
papers.notes: SEIR model for Ebola with hospitalization and burial compartments.

papers.title: Mathematical Modeling of Ebola Virus Disease: A Compartmental Approach
papers.notes: Compartmental model for 2014 Ebola outbreak. Includes treatment and isolation compartments.

papers.title: Compartmental Models for Measles Transmission: Impact of Vaccination
papers.notes: Classic SIR model for measles with vaccination. Age-structured version available.

papers.title: A Compartmental Model for Cholera Transmission with Water Contamination
papers.notes: SIR model with water contamination compartment. Includes environmental transmission.

papers.title: Compartmental Model for Zika Virus Transmission with Vector Control
papers.notes: Vector-borne model similar to dengue. Includes sexual transmission compartment.
